title: Dungeon Ember Enchantment System
description: A dungeon scene with a glowing pot of coals at its center. The user channels ember energy from the coals into the dungeon walls using custom shaders, painting heat distortion and emissive glow across surfaces. Energy is conserved between the coals and the walls, with undo/redo support and multi-input coupling between heat intensity, color temperature, and distortion strength.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that loads both PotOfCoals.glb (centered on the dungeon floor) and dungeon_warkarma.glb (surrounding environment). Use OrbitControls for camera, starting at position (0, 3, 6) looking at origin. Add a dim amber PointLight at the coals position and subtle ambient light. Implement a custom ShaderMaterial on the dungeon walls using vertex and fragment shaders. The fragment shader accepts uniforms: uHeatZones (array of 5 vec4s encoding xyz position + intensity), uColorTemp (float 0-1 from cool orange to white-hot), uDistortionStrength (float 0-1), and uCoalEnergy (float 0-1 representing remaining coal energy). The shader renders heat distortion via sine-based UV offset scaled by distortion strength, and additive emissive glow at each heat zone using distance falloff. Apply a pulsing ember shader to the PotOfCoals model whose brightness is driven by uCoalEnergy. Conservation law: total energy is fixed at 1.0. Energy transferred to walls reduces coal glow proportionally. Interactions: (1) Click on dungeon walls via raycasting to place up to 5 heat zones, each consuming 0.1 energy from coals. (2) A vertical slider controls uColorTemp globally. (3) A horizontal slider controls uDistortionStrength globally. (4) Right-click a placed heat zone to remove it, returning 0.1 energy to coals. (5) Ctrl+Z undoes the last action (placement, removal, or slider change), Ctrl+Y redoes. Store an action history stack supporting at least 14 steps. Display a HUD showing coal energy as a percentage bar and zone count. The coal shader should use time-based noise with amplitude modulated by uCoalEnergy. When coal energy reaches 0, disable further placements and flash a warning. All shader code must be inline in script tags. Ensure smooth 60fps rendering with requestAnimationFrame.
